# Private maximal footprints — scientific closeout

2026-10-10 UTC. CLOSED for the declared structural theorem and prospective verification contract; publication completion is reported only after immutable readback. This authoritative closeout supersedes the historical OPEN/pending statuses in the immutable RESULT, REPORT and REVIEW.

Prospective freeze191ebabb14efae2b3a847e519232d5b8f7c39292. Scientific/event/workflow commit703c05495e2a5b655e8f50bba491b8786e0594da. Integrated parentbdcd6fd4200e955e71a5cab72710600609d322fe.

The first event f7c4b9af140aec9fedb13f505d1edac94269f3df, run38082779963, passed verification, fresh reconstruction and Gemini mathematical review. Its publication gate stopped with an IndexError because the workflow omitted the independent checker's output-path argument. The Gemini publication step was skipped; no publication verdict exists for that run. The one-line workflow invocation was fixed and the complete pipeline rerun at the event above. All ten reviewed scientific inputs and the certificate remained byte-identical. The original first-run three ZIPs, four complete logs, raw mathematical answer/manifest, immutable inputs and metadata are preserved under evidence/private-cover/failed-attempt/. A separate executable failure reconciliation authenticates the cause, identities and unchanged scientific content.

[Theorem and frozen contract](COUPLED_C3_PRIVATE_COVER_RESULT.md), [execution report](COUPLED_C3_PRIVATE_COVER_REPORT.md), [internal review](COUPLED_C3_PRIVATE_COVER_REVIEW.md).

## What is proved
If every maximal original footprint has a root belonging to no other maximal footprint, if any first reserve is safely reachable, some first reserve is safely reachable while leaving one original maximal label pertype completely unchanged. This holds for EVERY choice of those original labels; it does not prescribe which non-anchor label becomes vacant first. The maxima can overlap; PRIVATE is equivalent to their number k equalling source hitting number, hence k=3or4 in the inherited setting.

Positive original floors force every maximal type to remain occupied. A safe exact-meet transfer cannot take its last occupant. We can therefore reserve one original actual label pertype as an unchanged cover and move only the other labels. Subtracting those anchors and their root contributions yields an exact isomorphism of the entire unrestricted and residual count graphs, not merely a one-way sufficient test. Every edge lifts from every actual residual assignment. Residual bookkeeping floors may be zero, but every original floor is preserved at every native slice.

This proves a structural no-movement result, not existence of a reserve. Source-component membership still decides accessibility. Source-component and global static minimum active counts have corresponding anchor-subtraction formulas, without a claim they coincide. Prescribed NON-anchor absence can be obtained by copying into an already vacant label and then deleting the target; it need not be the first vacancy. Exact labelled destinations and native shortest paths remain outside the count criterion.

Consequently a case forcing protection to change before ANY first vacancy must have a redundant maximal footprint: k>source hitting number. This is necessary, not sufficient. No general theorem about sources with redundant maxima is claimed.

## Complete verification
Run [38083110622](https://github.com/proteinfoldingengine/WetLabEngine/actions/runs/38083110622) is bound to the scientific/event commit above. All four jobs succeeded: verification, fresh reproduction, mathematical review and separate publication audit. Both original Gemini verdicts are ACCEPTED with no missing assumptions or counterexamples. Author reconciliation authenticates all33 mathematical and36 publication inputs, raw answer hashes and retry records; each final review used one response attempt.

The full frozen universe contains319 sources and638 floor-mode cases,1478 actual anchor choices and1734 expansions. Entire unrestricted graphs total3543 vertices and8877 edges. Full fixed-anchor labelled residual graphs total13826 vertices and42164 undirected edges, with both directed canonical native lifts verified. Every-representative quotient adjacency checks total75507, and1830 non-anchor rename witnesses are checked.343 cases have a reachable reserve;295 do not. These classifications are finite, while the structural theorem is analytical.

Fourteen saturated all-maximal-only controls have no vacancy. Two explicit saturated overlapping sources, at coretau3and4, release an extra label in exactly the declared two toggles while keeping every anchor unchanged; no general optimal-cost theorem is claimed. Two last-private-occupant meet controls reject the unsafe transfer. The no-PRIVATE triangle is rejected at theorem entry.

There are448703 original protected one-hidden-mask checks and268628 native slice occurrences, counted separately. Complete source/anchor/expansion/vertex/edge/component/lift/vacancy/rename identities are independently enumerated before hashing. The implementations share no imports and use bitmask/set representations, composition/multiset source-count enumeration, donor/pairwise edge construction and BFS/union-find components. No full raw incidence-cube campaign is claimed.

All26 new and253 inherited tests pass locally and in the original final CI logs,279 total. Initial22-test RED contains22 errors; four boundary controls were added during independent review. Both-direction canonical lift coverage and explicit boundary records were corrected before the scientific commit; the frozen theorem/universe were unchanged. Fresh jobs reproduce the full certificate and independent reconstruction, not all279 tests. Certificate SHA256:f4dad9a0dba31d85764f3dea65ec2c0325da38d9429ddb6d2ca36e81cb577b48.

Original final evidence under evidence/private-cover/ includes four unchanged ZIPs, four complete decoded job logs, raw Gemini answer texts/manifests, provenance gate, run/job/artifact metadata, immutable scientific input readbacks and executable author audit. The first failed run adds three unchanged ZIPs and four complete logs under failed-attempt/. Author audits and six adversarial evidence controls pass, without inflating the279 scientific tests. Separate publication audit and portable-layout checks accompany the evidence.

Both favorable Gemini reviews include an overly broad phrase about exact labelled targets. The author rejects that extension: the rename phase proves prescribed NON-anchor ABSENCE only. The mathematical review's upper-cover statement applies to full cores with anchors restored, not the residual-only bookkeeping graph. Frozen proof/code/report already state the correct scope. Original answers are preserved unchanged; [author reconciliation](COUPLED_C3_PRIVATE_COVER_RECONCILIATION.md) records these corrections and the failed-workflow chronology. [Separate publication audit](COUPLED_C3_PRIVATE_COVER_PUBLICATION_AUDIT.md) checks final originals and retained failure.

## Continuation
Next investigate sources with redundant maximal footprints: find structural conditions forcing cover movement before the first vacancy, construct a witness, or prove a stronger persistent-cover invariant. The PRIVATE class is now excluded from such witnesses. Do not conflate prescribed-label movement after an earlier reserve with movement required for ANY first reserve.

Broad C3/general C4 and native observation/access/source/outcome/committed progress remain OPEN and supplied where assumed. Path A active, Path B closed. No new native primitive, physical derivation, inserted geometry, fundamental-time/dark-matter variable or full-stack certification.

# Nonuniform five-type reserve availability — prospective theorem draft

OPEN pending computational verification and scientific closeout. Independently accepted analytical theorem; no new scientific enumeration performed before freeze. Parent weak-trace closeout7c9b6dd2b6b77176cfe9db125ed18276cf513ba0. Same five pair-root maxima M_i, all10 pair roots, positive integer source multiplicities a_i>=1, original palette size A=sum a_i. A graph G sets saturated original floor a_i+a_j on edge ij and floor1 on other roots. Original maximal domination, upper-four protection and original hidden family fixed. Broad C3/general C4/native premises OPEN.

## Static criterion for arbitrary positive multiplicities
A safe static reserve exists iff either G has an isolated vertex, or there is an independent set I in G with |I|>|N_G(I)| containing AT MOST ONE type of source multiplicity1. Equivalent local witnesses for no-isolate five-vertex G:
1. Two degree-one types sharing a neighbor (a cherry), with at least one of the two source multiplicities>=2.
2. An independent triple I with neighborhood size2, with at least two of its three multiplicities>=2.

Necessity: expand each active label of a hypothetical safe static reserve to an original maximal container. The resulting type counts n_i are nonnegative integers with sum n_i<=A-1, and all pair floors hold. All pair roots have floor>=1, so at most one n_i is zero. Let d_i=max(a_i-n_i,0), p_i=max(n_i-a_i,0). Since sum d_i>sum p_i, the integral layer-cake identities imply there is h>=1 with |D_h|>|P_h|, where D_h={i:d_i>=h}, P_h={i:p_i>=h}. Each saturated edge from i in D_h forces n_j-a_j>=a_i-n_i>=h. Thus D_h is independent and N(D_h) subset P_h. Any type in D_h with a_i=1 has n_i=0, so at most one such type exists.

If G has no isolates, N(D_h) is nonempty. On five vertices an independent deficient set has size2,3 or4. Size2 has neighborhood size1 and is a cherry. Size3 with neighborhood1 permits any two of its members as a cherry, choosing at least one multiplicity>=2; size3/neighborhood2 is the triple witness. Size4 has neighborhood1 and also yields an eligible cherry. This yields the two stated local alternatives.

Sufficiency: for any eligible deficient independent I, set n_i=a_i-1 on I, n_i=a_i+1 on N(I), and n_i=a_i elsewhere. Saturated floors hold since every neighbor of a decreased type is increased; no saturated edge joins two decreased types. At most one n_i is zero, so all nonedge floors1 hold and at least four maximal types remain occupied. Their maxima admit an actual four-label cover; thus the static core is safe with fewer than A active labels. The omitted labels are retained as empty labels in the same original palette. An isolated vertex alternatively permits deleting one original label in4 toggles, preserving four anchors from other types.

## Exact reachability criterion and fixed protection
For ALL positive integer a, a first reserve is reachable iff a static reserve exists AND minimum degree(G)<=1. Every reachable case has a route with FOUR unchanged actual original maximal anchors. Thus the uniform theorem extends to all positive nonuniform multiplicities in this five-type pair-root family. No statement yet for other footprint families or sources missing types.

Necessity of a static reserve is immediate. If minimum degree>=2, every original maximal type has a nonempty saturated trace with at least two incident roots, uniquely specifying its maximal container and containing the full allowed saturated trace. The inherited fingerprint invariant applies with the original floors a_i+a_j. Every original label stays active. This argument does not use uniform multiplicity.

Conversely, if there is an isolated vertex, delete a canonical label there in4 toggles. Otherwise choose an eligible cherry or independent triple supplied by the static criterion. For a cherry, its vertices have degree1. For an eligible triple I with N={a,b} and minimum degree<=1, some i in I has degree1: if all three had degree2, both neighborhood vertices would have degree>=3, contrary to the minimum-degree assumption. Choose N(i)={a}, choose j in I\{i} adjacent to b, and let k be the remaining member.

Anchor-selection lemma: a cherry changes two original types; a triple changes three. If at most one changed type has multiplicity1, choose that type as the excluded anchor type; if none is singleton, choose the target type. Freeze the first original label at each of the other four types. For every changed type, edit its first label if that type was excluded, and its second label otherwise. These editable labels exist and are distinct from all anchors. The target may therefore be the SECOND label of a type whose first label remains anchored. This is the needed nonuniform adjustment; exclusion need not equal target.

Cherry (i,a,j): shrink donor from type i to singleton root ia (3 deletions), add root aj (1 addition), delete target from type j (4 deletions). First vacancy at toggle8. Four anchors remain unchanged. Both saturated source edges ia and ja remain compensated; other saturated roots unchanged; nonedge floors follow from the fixed four-anchor cover. Original domination holds. This works for either ordered orientation of any eligible cherry, including a singleton donor with a duplicated target.

Triple (i,a,j,b,k): shrink donor i to ia (3 deletions); add aj iff G-edge; add ak iff G-edge; shrink donor j to jb (3 deletions); add bk iff G-edge; delete target k (4 deletions). All saturated losses are compensated before their deletion, as in the uniform proof. Nonedge floors1 follow from the four unchanged anchors. Original domination and upper-four hold throughout. Both donors retain their singleton roots; the target is the first absent label at the last edit. Cost10+1{aj in G}+degree_G(k)<=13. Every eligible ordered triple works with the adjusted anchor exclusion, even when its degree-one donor is singleton.

Arbitrary original protected hidden completions follow from inherited original-domination/upper-four safety. Floors and labels remain original throughout.

## Cost and obstruction boundaries
An isolated first vacancy has globally optimal cost4. If G has no isolated vertex, ANY first vacancy requires at least8 toggles: at the absent target's original type v choose saturated neighbor w; root vw loses that target but must keep its original a_v+a_w supporters, so an endpoint supporter y originally outside {v,w} must be gained. Domination forces y into M_v or M_w, which intersects its original maximum in one root, so y requires>=3 deletions and>=1 addition. The absent target requires4 deletions. Distinct labels give>=8. Thus eligible cherries achieve the global optimum8 without isolates. Triple<=13 is achieved only, not claimed optimal.

The only no-isolate five-vertex graphs admitting a deficient independent set but having minimum degree>=2 are the20 labelled K23 graphs with an optional edge between the size-two part. With nonuniform positive multiplicities, these graphs have a static reserve iff at least two vertices of their independent size-three part have multiplicity>=2. No formula for their general static minimum is claimed here. When this condition holds the static reserve is unreachable; otherwise static absence is itself obstructed. Other statically infeasible graphs can have weak traces; weak traces alone are not a reserve theorem.

## Frozen complete finite verification contract
1. All1024 labelled graphs G and ALL32 positive source profiles a in{1,2}^5, with actual palette offsets and original edge floors a_i+a_j:32768 cases. Independently reconstruct every complete count-graph vertex/exact-meet edge/component/static minimum/source component. Compare full canonical identities before hashes. Verify static criterion, reachability iff static and minimum degree<=1, fingerprint/COUNT-GRAPH-source-isolation equivalence (not raw native-state isolation), and exact capacity-conditioned K23 obstruction identities. The all-positive-integer statement rests on the proof, not this finite binary-profile campaign. A count-isolated source can still permit safe unlocked-root native edits; no native singleton-component claim is made.
2. For every such(G,a), every isolated type gets4 edits; every ordered eligible cherry gets8; every ordered eligible triple (i,a,j,b,k) in no-isolate minimum-degree1 graphs gets the stated<=13 route. Canonical anchor exclusion is the unique changed singleton type if present, otherwise target. Editable label is first at excluded type, second at other changed types; first labels at the four nonexcluded types are anchors. Ascending root deletion order, additions aj,ak then bk. Include singleton donors/duplicated targets explicitly. Not every actual label choice/edit order.
3. Every native slice and every original protected one-hidden mask, deduplicated by(G,a,core), separate occurrences. Exact palette/floors/domination/upper-four/anchor immutability, first vacancy and achieved/optimal flags. Independently reconstruct every declared count vertex/static minimum vector and every eligible local certificate, including its canonical ±1 witness. This does not enumerate arbitrary labelled native static cores, all actual label choices or all edit orders; no supplied case lists. Reject profile/G/source/floor/count/vertex/edge/component/anchor/excluded-type/edit/hidden-mask omissions/corruptions, unsafe two-singleton cherry, insufficient-capacity triple and missing required saturated compensation. Preserve all480 lower-bound footprint witnesses.
4. Genuine RED before implementation, new GREEN plus344 inherited scientific tests. Fresh full byte-identical certificate/canonical companion and complete independent reconstruction. Separate mathematical and publication reviews, exact-event CI, original unchanged archive bytes/full logs/raw answers/input hashes/failures, author adjudication and separate final publication audit. Both continuation indices and immutable text/binary/head readback before scoped closeout. No broad C3/general C4/native premise closeout.

## Prospective analytical review
A fresh independent reviewer ACCEPTED the layer-cake static criterion, local witness reduction, nonuniform fingerprint/count-isolation argument, singleton-donor anchor selection, eight-toggle bound and capacity-conditioned K23 obstruction, without enumeration or edits. The author incorporated explicit count-source isolation and canonical count/local static-witness scope clarifications before freeze.

# C3 native coverage/routing origin — search, coherent-record and Genesis route screen

Date: 2026-10-09 UTC.
Status: OPEN author research note; this candidate shortcut is unsupported by the inspected sources.
Source/parent:248b1cfbdd29063a3806fca5f66d861d356aa897.
This is source reconciliation, not a new theorem, universal obstruction, Gemini acceptance or scientific checkpoint closure. Existing repair closeouts are unchanged.

## Concrete obligation
The closed deficit repair computes a safe coverage certificate from known role incidence patterns and routes actual edits using labelled roots, current pool roles, a known host and committed-edit phase. It does not initialize or make those records accessible.
The question examined here was whether earlier code named native_record_search/native_record_trace, the coherent-record implementation, or a Genesis provenance anchor already supplies that missing input.

## Findings from actual definitions and code

| Inspected route | Actual construction | C3 consequence |
|---|---|---|
| C3 event initialization | Reconstructs a count from a supplied seed and complete valid event directions; reconstructing supports additionally needs event labels and exact seed supports | It is an update theorem, not acquisition of the role template or actual event ledger |
| C3 event-channel result | Distinguishes event occurrence/address from event sign and payload information | An ordered occurrence list alone cannot be promoted into the richer ledger; this is an inherited result, not a new obstruction |
| C3 native-interface result | Extracts information from already initialized full-palette miss counts | Definability from hidden supports is not observer-accessible initialization |
| v15.46 native_record_trace.py | Verifies pinned bytes for a supplied six-qubit demo; returns failure at native joint-state provenance and marks later interfaces unexecuted | It is a static provenance audit, not a native-record generator |
| v15.46 native_record_search.py | Checks five declared source files and their frozen markers; returns no primitive-derived record found in that bounded scope | The function name does not imply an initializer. Its scope explicitly excludes an archive-wide absence claim |
| v15.15 coherent_records.py | initial_joint(rho) inserts a supplied system matrix into a supplied blank register sector; copy_gate constructs controlled copying; encoding requires a supplied compatible schedule | It implements conditional correlations. No map from C3 labelled incidence roots, roles or native edits to those registers/gates is constructed in this source |
| v15.15 actual-record boundary | branch_operator takes a records string; audit enumerates branches and sets actual_record_selected=None | Coherent writing and conditional branch evaluation are distinct from supplying an actual resolved record to this controller |
| v15.09 carrier-origin report | Preserves the missing cross-domain node/site relation; internal structure does not supply that relation | Sorting core roles against register labels would add an unsupported alignment. This report's historical theorem was not re-executed here |
| v15.56 genesis_base.py | Classifies a Genesis Pin as insufficient without certified provenance/lineage/recoverability/repair-compatible descent maps; no shared pin is assumed | Naming a common origin does not construct the C3 initializer or incidence-to-register connection |

The v15.15 construction is a real conditional reversible record implementation, not a defective model. It shows what follows WHEN its carrier, blank registers, copy/control gates and schedules are supplied. It is not legitimate to import those premises as newly derived C3 native machinery.
Likewise the v15.46 audits do exactly their stated job. Their negative provenance flags are not evidence that all possible native record constructions are impossible.

## Candidate disposition
The attempted shortcut “use the existing native-record code to initialize the deficit controller” is not supported. The candidate stops before any incidence-to-register encoding or new actuator/observation rule is adopted.
This is a source-specific failed route assessment. It does not prove that the required interface cannot be derived directly in the incidence system, and it does not assert that quantum machinery is necessary.
No new numerical campaign or Gemini request was issued: there is no new positive construction or novel impossibility theorem here to test. Re-executing the closed repair would test the conditional theorem again rather than answer its input-origin question.

## Exact next construction gate
A future candidate must name an inherited native input I and exhibit:
1. an initialization map or relation producing the required coverage/routing record from I, with each input field's prior source stated;
2. a justified action connection from the named incidence request to the existing native update;
3. a retained result from which the actual edit phase can be tracked, with system-side information kept distinct from observer access;
4. an update preserving the certificate and routing contract through the repair.
For a quantum-register route, the carrier, blank registers, coupling and incidence-to-register map each need their own native derivation. For a direct incidence route, correlated accessible subsystems and their update must actually be constructed. A full-state verifier or a stipulated projection does not supply either.
Do not insert commit-every-legal-request semantics, an external acknowledgment, hidden-state access or a representation chosen to produce the desired answer. Do not repackage the known all-NOOP example as another discovery.

The current blocker is a missing mathematical construction of this connection, not an API outage, a missing permission or a failing repair proof. Broader C3 remains OPEN. The three recent C4 repair results remain scoped CLOSED.

Eleven source files were read at the immutable parent. Returned blob IDs matched its recursive Git tree; Git blob SHA-1 was independently recomputed from every UTF-8 content. Per-file SHA256 and immutable links are preserved in [the source manifest](evidence/native-record-origin/COVERAGE_ORIGIN_SCREEN.json).

# C3 origin re-entry: bootstrap routes do not construct their inputs

Date:2026-10-09 (America/Phoenix). Parent d31a9ef0a7b92947e61602cda192aa4d5fb1a016.
Status: OPEN author research decision. No new theorem, impossibility result, independent review or scientific checkpoint closure is claimed.

## The actual frontier
The recent admission and record-transfer results are useful conditional mathematics. They do not establish native acquisition of their inputs. The current proved chain begins with a correctly initialized and accessible global record:

global singleton/pair miss field -> outside-root singleton profile -> exact admission bit -> restricted safe repair policy.

The first arrow is the record-transfer identity; the next is the empty-intersection criterion. Their composition is valid WHEN the global field and template are supplied. The missing connection is from previously justified native input/update objects to an accessible retained field or another sufficient admission certificate. Global moments are one sufficient route, not a necessary representation of every possible solution.

The next research objective therefore remains acquisition/retention, not further algebraic simplification of the decoder or another conditional repair protocol.

## Candidate routes checked against actual sources

| Candidate | What the inspected source permits | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| Use the record-transfer producer as an initializer | source(b,c,z) constructs full supports including hidden mask z; produce() sums miss indicators over those full supports before calling decode(m) | Correct offline verification, not acquisition from the observer's available core. No code defect; using it as a native sensor would import the answer-bearing input |
| Initialize by the dynamic residual update law | Updates M from its previous correct value and the named active root's old/new support; source explicitly leaves initial M and observer access unresolved | Does not bootstrap either its own seed or active-support access. Reusing this conditional law is not a derivation of those premises |
| Reconstruct through ordered events | The event-init result requires a legitimate seed plus complete observed event directions; full support reconstruction needs labels and seed supports | Ordered updates alone are not the complete observed ledger. Assuming that ledger simply relocates the missing retained-record input |
| Treat an actual visible successful request as its own certificate | Existing guarded readout allows sound positive certificates after suitable committed edits; its complete relation still includes NOOP for legal requests | A useful conditional observation does not derive guard enforcement, actual outcome resolution or observer access. The earlier internal-record attempt already identifies this distinction; do not count it as a new no-go result |

The complete core-probe relation is a specified set of permitted successors. It is not by itself an implementation of enforcement, an outcome-selection law or a construction of retained observer memory. Conversely, the restricted admitted repair's guard redundancy remains valid; this source finding does not reopen it.

The internal-record attempt already demonstrates why adding "commit every legal request" changes the model. That rule was not adopted here. Neither an external acknowledgment, full-state read, new sensor nor new physical coupling has been inserted.

## Concrete acceptance gate for the next candidate
Name a previously justified native input domain I, with the source of each available field. Then supply:

1. A carrier/record connection identifying where the sufficient information is represented internally, and how its initial correlation with the hidden incidence state is obtained. Defining M from hidden supports is not an accessible initialization map.
2. An action connection showing that the existing native update actually creates or changes that representation under the named request, with allowed versus realized outcomes kept distinct.
3. A retained output that is legitimately available across ordered slices, together with a decoder for the admission predicate. Do not assume that a set of possible records is an actual observed record.
4. An explicit account of initial protected-band knowledge, template/address availability and any complete-palette requirement. Alternative certificate constructions may remove some of these inputs, but must prove that removal.

A candidate may be conditional on inherited native premises, provided those premises really come from the cited construction and are not newly supplied copies of the desired record. Nothing here asserts that quantum registers, global moments or guaranteed progress are necessary for every possible observer. The negative findings apply to the inspected routes only.

## Research decision and evidence
No candidate inspected here closes the input-origin connection. This is a missing mathematical construction, not a permission or API problem. No additional scientific enumeration or Gemini request was launched: there is no new frozen positive mechanism or novel obstruction to test. Repeating the closed transfer/repair campaigns would verify their conditional statements again without addressing this gap.

Eight current source contents, including the index/continuation used for publication, were read at the immutable parent. Their returned Git blob identities were independently recomputed from UTF-8 bytes. The source manifest is evidence/native-record-origin/ORIGIN_REENTRY_SOURCE_CHECK.json. This is source integrity and author reconciliation only; historical execution was not rerun or recertified. No prior proof, review or rejecting control was altered.

# Uniformly safe core writing — scoped obstruction closeout

Date2026-10-09. Status: scoped CLOSED mathematical obstruction; candidate interaction class OBSTRUCTED for the stated initial-record task. Broad C3/C4 remain OPEN.

## Result
The proposed interaction class is OBSTRUCTED for initializing an exact record of an initially hidden predicate: uniformly safe native single-incidence writes, observed only through the complete visible core and transcript-derived memory. This is a scoped mathematical obstruction, not universal observer impossibility or closure of broader C3.

For every named native toggle, projecting after the toggle equals applying the command's known core effect to the old projection. Uniform-before-issue safety makes that same toggle legal in both initially indistinguishable worlds. Induction therefore preserves equal transcripts, memory and stopping decisions. This holds even when core record incidences change and every command commits. It is not the old all-NOOP argument.

The theorem permits core AND hidden writes on arbitrary finite carriers. Its target is the initial hidden predicate, not a necessarily conserved current predicate. In the optional-NOOP relation, every common resolution mask realizes the same visible trace in both worlds, so possible trace languages agree. Probability-law equality requires a common hidden-independent resolution law; arbitrary hidden-dependent kernels are not covered. All-commit is a diagnostic restriction, not a newly derived physical success rule.

The earlier spectator-only result held the core fixed. This result broadens the action/carrier/memory class and treats actual changing core incidences as records. The observation restriction remains load-bearing: unlike the older special carrier's constant-tau output, it does not permit arbitrary tau/cardinality/count observations. On that older carrier those additional outputs were constant, so there is no conflict.

The exact admission pair is an application: both worlds have identical core and protected initial states but opposite outside-intersection predicates. A private observed scratch label can be added and removed safely in both, producing matching nonconstant committed traces. Guarded core-readout remains valid because informative attempts can be unsafe in one initially possible world; state-dependent guard exclusion breaks the common-transition condition.

## Prospective and execution provenance
- Parent c4f15519915e7e832ae0fcbe9c7872adc9000b27.
- Scope/proof freeze14fc8eafc5af1cbf263c3845c883324587d0e0e6.
- Test/absent-code RED a93adf701ca1eae5922899f46e5ced34926094a5.
- Scientific/workflow d7c8f1b3e0ca1b66af0cf379fa25a65885c484e8.
- Actions run37961753132.

All28 new tests pass: four positive contracts and24 corruption controls. All28 immediate inherited record-transfer tests pass,56 total. RED demonstrates missing implementations; GREEN requires rejection of corrupt certificates. This is not a full foundational replay, numbered retained-stage closure or post-merge certification.

The complete bounded universe has128 states,56 admissible states,776 individual guarded outcomes,10 unordered hidden-world pairs with repetition,100 paired states,688 uniformly safe paired edges and76 nonuniform boundaries. The alphabet has five core switch positions and ten signed requests; hidden edits occur in the general proof only. The 688 edges include both commit and NOOP resolutions. The scratch trace contains four actual changes and is legal in the baseline00/11 worlds. No claim of exhaustive general-carrier enumeration follows.

Independent reconstruction compares all source classifications, support/tau/floor values, commands, guarded edges, every paired node/edge, nonuniform boundary and application fixture. It uses set supports, representative-union covers, separately derived closed guard conditions and explicit physical toggle checks, versus producer literal support masks/subset covers/direct edge enumeration. Certificate79002 bytes; SHA256 `50ab05cc8c7c687922d33cf2c08f4fc880bf32798e7cc1e607417e867b439969`.

## What research must do next
Further uniformly safe incidence-writing protocols with this same observation interface cannot solve the initial admission-record problem. A positive candidate must justify where a hidden-dependent observable effect comes from: an enforced admissibility/resolution mechanism or another already-derived interaction/observable outside the projection identity. A hidden-dependent outcome kernel cannot simply be inserted as a measurement rule. Existing conditional readout shows possible guard-mediated records, but does not construct native enforcement, actual selection or access.

No full hidden-state read, acknowledgment, mandatory-success rule, sensor, physical force, geometry, dark matter or fundamental time has been added. Broader C3 origin/access and general C4 remain OPEN. Earlier scoped results remain unchanged.

## Author interpretation controls

# Nonuniform five-type reserve classification — final scoped closeout

Status: **CLOSED / CERTIFIED within the declared nonuniform five-type first-reserve theorem and frozen verification scope.** Exact-event CI, both external reviews, original-evidence audit, fresh separate publication review and immutable evidence-publication readback all passed. Broad C3/general C4/native observation/access/source/outcome/committed progress remain supplied and OPEN.

## Scientific advance
The uniform-multiplicity restriction is removed for the five pair-root maximal types. Every type has an arbitrary positive integer number a_i of original labels; original saturated floors are a_i+a_j on graph edges and1 elsewhere. A static safe reserve exists exactly when there is an isolated vertex or a deficient independent set I with |I|>|N(I)| containing at most one singleton source type. A first reserve is reachable exactly when a static reserve exists AND minimum degree(G)<=1.

Every reachable case has FOUR unchanged actual original maximal anchors. Choose the unique changed singleton type as the unanchored type, if present; otherwise choose the target. This permits a singleton donor and a duplicated target whose first label remains anchored. Thus nonuniformity alone does not force protection movement before the first vacancy in this family.

The new static-necessity proof uses integral deficit levels: a strict total reduction yields a level h with more decreased types D_h than increased types P_h; saturated floors force N(D_h) subset P_h. Positive pair floors allow at most one zero count, hence at most one singleton source type among D_h. The corresponding ±1 independent-set/neighborhood adjustment proves sufficiency. On five vertices this reduces to eligible cherries or triples, besides isolates. The inherited saturated fingerprint proves the lock for minimum degree>=2 without uniform multiplicity.

Isolated first vacancy has globally optimal cost4. Eligible cherries achieve8, globally optimal when there are no isolated vertices. General eligible independent-triple routes achieve<=13; no optimality claim. The endpoint lower bound8 allows arbitrary histories and moving covers. No cardinality restoration, exact exchange or committed progress is derived by this first-reserve theorem.

Only the20 labelled K23/optional-two-part-edge saturated graphs can be statically feasible yet locked. For a given positive source profile, that occurs exactly when at least two types in the independent three-part have multiplicity>=2. No general static-minimum formula is claimed. Count-source isolation is distinguished from raw native-state isolation: safe unlocked-root edits may remain possible.
